text:
nina: deploy-bot starting staged rollout v4.0.0 -> 7% (embed-heavy routes) during change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. monitoring p95/p99, 5xx, and memory. warming strategy=aggressive-prefetch.

deploy-bot: [ROLLOUT] id=deploy-8612345678 target=7% version=v4.0.0 routes=[embed, rerank] warmup=aggressive-prefetch

ash: seeing small uptick in mem pressure in eu-central hosts (~12%). p99 embed latency +30ms. not alarming yet.

ops-sre: set auto-pause at p99>500ms OR 5xx>0.5% sustained 1.5m. also watch host eviction-rate and cpu steal.

lee: curious if aggressive-prefetch doubled the prefix loads. adding a debug flag to reduce parallel prefetch.

nina: ok apply debug flag then. deploy-bot schedule is bump to 25% in 8m. pls ack hold/continue.

deploy-bot: scheduled bump 7% -> 25% in 8m. react :white_check_mark: to go, :no_entry_sign: to stop.

ash: waiting on debug flag results. hold from me.

lee: applying debug flag to warmup controller now. will report in 90s.

deploy-bot: warmup-controller flag updated across canary nodes.

ops-sre: eviction-rate trending down after flag. eu-central host mem still slightly elevated but stable. recommend hold until 5m steady.

nina: pausing planned bump. @deploy-bot pause rollout reason="warmup-induced eviction spike, investigating"

deploy-bot: [ACTION] Rollout paused at 7% by nina. Reason="warmup-induced eviction spike". Options: fall back affected routes to v3.9.x, pin regions, or full rollback.

ash: impact seems limited to embed route in eu-central. can we route embed->v3.9.4 in eu-central only?

ops-sre: yes, we can apply routing override for embed in eu-central. will push patch and cordon the two hottest hosts.

lee: pushed patch: embed.eu-central -> v3.9.4. propagation ~20s.

ash: embed latency back to baseline p99 180ms -> 160ms. no 5xx. good.

ops-sre: cordoned hosts drained ~50%, eviction spikes decreased. still want to revert aggressive-prefetch default for staged rollouts. opening PR now: infra/warmup/smoothing.

nina: decision poll: if no further regressions in 7m, resume bump to 25% with smoothing enabled. thumbs?

sam: :white_check_mark:

lee: :white_check_mark: monitor 10m after bump

ash: :white_check_mark: but prefer gradual 15% then 25% if all green

deply-bot: (typo)

deploy-bot: scheduling incremental bump to 15% in 7m. Reply with :no_entry_sign: to cancel.

ops-sre: note for postmortem: add warmup smoothing, region-aware prefetch caps, and improved rollout telemetry for memory trends.

nina: thanks team. I'll update release notes: "Staged rollout v4.0.0 paused briefly due to warmup prefetch causing host eviction in eu-central; applied local fallback and smoothing; resuming incremental rollout." Keeping thread for follow-ups.
